newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RUGBY LEAGUE-TOOVEY TO CAPTAIN AUSTRALIA FOR FIRST TIME.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY LEAGUE-TOOVEY TO CAPTAIN AUSTRALIA FOR FIRST TIME.

text.p: named on Sunday as captain of the Australian rugby league side
to play Papua New Guinea in Port Moresby on October 6.
Toovey, leading his country for the first time, takes over
from Sydney City lock Brad Fittler, who has a groin injury.
Toovey won the man of the match award on Sunday after Manly
beat St George 20-8 in the Australian Rugby League grand final.
Toovey's Manly team mate, second-rower Daniel Gartner, is
one of three new caps in the 18-man squad for the test with PNG.
The others are North Sydney back Michael Buettner and Sydney
Geoff Toovey (captain), Wayne Bartrim, Tim Brasher, Michael
Buettner, Mark Carroll, Mark Coyne, Daniel Gartner, Paul
Harragon, Terry Hill, Andrew Johns, Gary Larson, Steve Menzies,
